name: okmr_webapp
description: UBC Okanagan Marine Robotics web app + Discord bot over a modular database & storage layer.

scripts.db:d1:migrate:local: wrangler d1 migrations apply okmr-db --local --config bot/wrangler.toml
scripts.db:d1:migrate:remote: node scripts/cf-preflight.mjs --require OKMR_ALLOW_D1_REMOTE && wrangler d1 migrations apply okmr-db --remote --config bot/wrangler.toml
scripts.web:cf:dry-run: node scripts/cf-preflight.mjs && npm run cf:build --workspace web && wrangler deploy --dry-run --config web/wrangler.toml --outdir /tmp/okmr-web-dry-run
